title: Forgive Always! 💛 Seventy Times Seven | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Two best friends, one broken toy rocket! 🚀💔 In this Sunday School lesson for kids, Bishoy and Philo blame each other until Abouna prays the Our Father and leaves out one very important line. Kids learn what forgiveness is, how Jesus washes our hearts clean, and what Jesus told Saint Peter: forgive not seven times, but seventy times seven!

📖 Memory verse: "Then Jesus said to Peter, I do not say to you up to seven times, but up to seventy times seven." (Matthew 18:21-22)
🎯 Lesson: Forgiveness. God forgives all our sins when we say sorry, and the Holy Spirit helps us forgive others. Forgiveness brings happiness, love, peace and friendship.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
